meta.compiled_by: research pass over public BEL notices via Firecrawl web search
meta.what_this_is: A working inventory of BEL load centres and distribution feeders, assembled from BEL's own published outage and load-shedding notices. BEL does not publish a feeder directory or feeder service-area boundaries anywhere. Everything here is reconstructed from the area lists BEL prints in its notices.
meta.what_this_is_not: This is NOT an official BEL feeder map. Area lists are as-printed in individual notices, which are usually partial: a notice names the areas affected that day, not every area on the feeder. Treat each entry as evidence, not as a boundary.

confidence_levels.bel_reposted: BEL notice quoted by BEL's own social account or a Belize news outlet
confidence_levels.named_only: feeder is known to exist because a notice named it, but no area list was captured

known_gaps: Belize City feeders 1, 5 and 7: named by neither notices nor the IRP, areas unknown
Ladyville Feeder 1: feeder and zones named in a notice, areas not captured
Ladyville Feeder 3: known from the IRP only, never in a public notice, areas unknown
Independence Feeder 2: exists per PUC 2024 rate filing (6.6kV being converted to 22kV), areas unknown
Caye Caulker: confirmed as a load centre by the IRP, feeder numbering still unknown
Punta Gorda Feeder 3 and above: searched for and not found, so Punta Gorda probably has only two feeders
Area lists marked truncated:true were cut off in the source snippet and are incomplete
closed_gaps: 2026-09-08: Westlake reclassified from load centre to transmission substation, per IRP Table 4-6.
2026-09-08: Caye Caulker confirmed as one of BEL's eleven load centres.
2026-09-08: Ladyville feeder count established as three.
2026-09-08: Belize City established as six 6.6 kV feeders off a single 20 MVA transformer, as of 2021.
2026-09-08: Substation inventory added from IRP chapter 14.

load_centers_source: The eleven load centres above match BEL's own demand accounting in Table 4-6 of the Siemens/BEL Integrated Resource Plan filed with the PUC (2022 study, 2021 data). BEL calls the Belize City load centre simply 'Belize'. Westlake was listed as a load centre in the first draft of this file and has been corrected: it is a transmission substation, not a load centre.

substations.name: Belize I
substations.note: The existing Belize City substation. Single transformer, 20 MVA, supplying six 6.6 kV feeders. Single incoming 115 kV line from Westlake, flagged in the IRP as a reliability violation.

substations.name: Belize II
substations.note: PROPOSED in the IRP, not built as of the 2022 study. Intended to take the 22 kV Belize City load currently fed from Westlake.

substations.name: Westlake
substations.note: Mile 8 George Price Highway. 15 MVA. Supplies the WST-F1 22 kV feeder plus the whole Ladyville load. Also the site of BEL's emergency generation.

substations.name: Ladyville
substations.note: Fed from Westlake by a 16 MVA 22 kV line.

substations.name: Banak
substations.note: 10/14 MVA. Allows transfer of 6.6 kV Belize City load onto the 22 kV system.

substations.name: Palloti
substations.note: 10/14 MVA. Same role as Banak.

substations.name: North Ladyville Switching
substations.note: PROPOSED. On the Maskall to Westlake line, about 10 miles from Westlake.

substations.name: Maskall
substations.note: Northern transmission node on the line toward Westlake.

substations.name: San Pedro 1
substations.note: 7/10 MVA. Ambergris Caye.

substations.name: San Pedro 2
substations.note: 5.4/7 MVA, the smaller of the pair.

substations.name: Chan Chen
substations.note: Northern transmission substation. Carries the interconnection toward Mexico via Xul-Ha.

substations.name: Corozal
substations.note: Supplies Corozal feeders F1 to F4 in the IRP's transformer loading analysis.

substations.name: Orange Walk
substations.note: Transformer capacity analysed in IRP tables 14-24 and 14-25.

substations.name: Belcogen
substations.note: Bagasse cogeneration plant at the sugar factory, with its own supply section in the IRP.

substations.name: Belmopan
substations.note: IRP flags the substation layout as not up to code and recommends rebuild by 2025.

substations.name: San Ignacio
substations.note: Own supply section in the IRP (14.6.7).

substations.name: Dangriga
substations.note: Own supply section in the IRP (14.6.11).

substations.name: Mullins River
substations.note: Appears in the IRP's PV-by-substation table as 'Mullings River'. Only one mention, so treat the spelling and the role as uncertain.

substations.name: Independence
substations.note: Own supply section in the IRP (14.6.4).

substations.name: Punta Gorda
substations.note: Southern terminus of the transmission system.

substations.name: Xul-Ha
substations.note: Mexican side of the CFE interconnection. Named in IRP contingency analysis.

feeder_naming.note: BEL's internal feeder codes, as used in the IRP's network model. The public outage notices never use these codes, they use plain language such as 'Belize City Feeder 6'. Mapping between the two is not published.

codes_observed.BZE-F01 to BZE-F06: Belize City, six 6.6 kV feeders off Belize I, total coincident peak about 18.4 MW in 2021
codes_observed.LDV-F01 to LDV-F03: Ladyville, three feeders, total about 9.6 MW
codes_observed.WST-F1: Westlake, the 22 kV feeder supplied directly from that substation, about 7.2 MW

open_discrepancies.issue: Belize City feeder numbering does not reconcile
open_discrepancies.detail: The IRP records six 6.6 kV Belize City feeders (BZE-F01 to F06) as of 2021. BEL's public notices name a 'Belize City Feeder 8'. Either the 22 kV feeders fed from Westlake are numbered above 6 in the public scheme, or the count grew after the study. Not resolved. Do not assume Feeder 8 is one of BZE-F01 to F06.

open_discrepancies.issue: Ladyville Feeder 3 has never appeared in a public notice
open_discrepancies.detail: The IRP says Ladyville has three feeders. Only Feeders 1 and 2 have been seen in outage or load-shedding notices. Feeder 3 is listed here on IRP authority alone, with no area list.

sources.note: BEL's own outage table. Server-rendered HTML. The only authoritative source here.
PUC rate filing. Names Independence Feeder #2 and its voltage conversion.

Siemens PTI study for BEL, filed with the PUC. 15.2MB, 353 pages, 2021 network data. Downloaded and parsed 2026-09-08. Source of the load centre list, the substation inventory, the feeder naming convention and the Belize City and Ladyville feeder counts. It is a generation and transmission plan, so it does not enumerate distribution feeder service areas.
PUC final decision. Names San Pedro and Corozal substation standardisation projects.
BEL's own page. Load-shedding schedules appear here and are never posted to the Power Updates page.

Load-shedding schedules quoted verbatim by Hot Off The Press Belize, Love FM, Channel 5, Breaking Belize News, CTV3, East Radio, Corozal Live, Corozal Daily, Ambergris Today and San Pedro Sun. Most feeder area lists in this file come from these reposts.
